doc: Observe a game running on its own, play it as a person does, step and seek its time, and ask what would be.

tools.name: world.observe
tools.description: What a player on this tier is shown at this frame, with the frame and the state's hash

tools.name: world.state
tools.description: The frame, the state's hash, whether the game is over, and the frames it can be sought within

tools.name: world.act
tools.description: A player's actions, as a person's: the state shows them from `effective`, no sooner than the tier's reaction after `seen`, and they hold until the next
tools.undo: world.seek to the frame before it took effect

then.why: play steps on: the action shows from `effective`
read what a player is shown now

seen.description: the frame they were decided on (the latest played when none is given)

axis.description: up to four axes, each -1 to 1: [1]

pointer.description: [x, y], each 0 to 1 of the game's area

tools.name: world.step
tools.description: Plays steps; only where the agent steps the game (an owner's clock refuses it)
tools.undo: world.seek to the frame it began at

then.why: read what a player is shown now

steps.description: how many (1 when none is given)

watch.description: a place in what the player is shown, read as the steps go by: a JSON pointer into the view ("/score"; "" is the whole view). The answer's `watched` is [{frame, value}]

every.description: with `watch`: read every this many steps (1 when none is given), and after the last; at most 600 readings

tools.name: world.seek
tools.description: Returns to a frame within the history kept; what is played from there is a new branch
tools.undo: none within the runtime: what came after the frame is another branch's

then.why: read where the game's time is

tools.name: world.branch
tools.description: What would be if given actions were given now: the future's view and hash some steps ahead — the actions taking effect as the tier's reaction allows, as `world.act` would have them; the game itself untouched

steps.description: how far ahead (1 when none is given)

buttons.description: held from when the action takes effect, pressed as it does

then.description: what follows: actions each with `after`, the step of the branch it is given at (a press and its release)

tiers.name: human
tiers.doc: As a person plays: shown what is drawn, a tenth of a second's reaction, ten actions a second.

tiers.name: assist
tiers.doc: Privileged: shown everything, no reaction time, no limit.

tasks.name: look-at-the-game
tasks.summary: Read what a player is shown and where the game's time is

tasks.name: play-a-moment
tasks.summary: Hold an axis as a player does, play half a second, and look again

tasks.name: watch-it-change
tasks.summary: Hold an axis and read what the player is shown every ten steps while half a second is played: one request for the whole stretch (`watch` takes a place in the view, as "/score"; "" is all of it)

tasks.name: ask-before-acting
tasks.summary: See where an action would lead some steps ahead, the game itself untouched
